name: Codersly ERP: ERP for Small Business with HRM, CRM, Accounting & WooCommerce Pro Placeholder
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly ERP is an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It helps small business owners, startups, agencies, service providers, local companies, and WordPress site admins manage basic HRM, CRM, and Accounting records from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Use Codersly ERP when you need a simple small business ERP plugin inside WordPress for employee records, departments, designations, announcements, leave requests, holidays, CRM contacts, companies, customer groups, notes, tasks, customers, vendors, transactions, products or services, reports, settings, and CSV import/export tools.

The Free plugin includes practical admin screens for daily business record management and shows clear Pro placeholders for advanced premium ERP modules. Premium business logic, WooCommerce sync, automation, and advanced workflows are not included in the Free plugin.

Key Free Features

  • Admin dashboard for small business ERP management
  • Company profile and setup wizard scaffold
  • Basic HRM screens for small business employee management
  • Employee, department, designation, announcement, search, import, and export screens
  • Leave request, holiday, policy, entitlement, calendar, and HRM report screens
  • CRM contacts, companies, groups, notes, tasks, and CRM report screens
  • Accounting customers, vendors, transactions, products or services, reports, and settings screens
  • Tools, settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens
  • WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder for orders, customers, products, stock, sales reports, and ERP accounting sync
  • Improved admin navigation with module-specific icons and Codersly ERP sidebar brand icon
  • Pro placeholders without premium business logic

ERP for Small Business

Codersly ERP is built for small business teams that want an admin-based ERP system inside WordPress. The plugin focuses on simple business record management instead of complex enterprise-level ERP workflows.

Small business owners can use the Free version to organize basic HRM, CRM, Accounting, company, report, and settings screens from one WordPress admin menu. Advanced automation and premium ERP workflows are shown as Pro placeholders only.

HRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes basic HRM screens for employee management, departments, designations, announcements, leave requests, holidays, leave policies, leave entitlements, leave calendar, and HRM reports.

These screens are useful for small businesses that need simple employee and leave record management inside the WordPress admin dashboard.

CRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes CRM screens for contacts, companies, customer groups, notes, tasks, and CRM reports. Small teams can use these screens to organize customer and company information without leaving WordPress.

Accounting for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes Accounting screens for customers, vendors, transactions, products or services, reports, and settings. These screens are designed for simple admin-based business record management inside WordPress.

WooCommerce Integration Pro Placeholder

Codersly ERP Free includes a WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder under the Accounting area. This screen explains premium WooCommerce-related ERP workflows such as order sync, customer sync, product sync, stock or inventory sync, sales reports, and ERP accounting sync.

WooCommerce sync logic is not included in the Free plugin. The Free screen is provided only as a clear upgrade path for users who need WooCommerce ERP automation in Codersly ERP Pro.

Free vs Pro Clarity

Codersly ERP Free provides admin screens, basic business record management, CSV tools, and Pro placeholders.

Premium workflows such as Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Accounting Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, WooCommerce Integration, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and third-party Integrations require Codersly ERP Pro.

Upgrade to Codersly ERP Pro for premium ERP features:
https://codersly.com/product/codersly-erp-pro-for-small-business-wordpress-plugin-license/

Who Is Codersly ERP For?

Codersly ERP is built for small businesses, startups, local companies, agencies, service providers, and WordPress site owners who want an admin-based ERP for Small Business with HRM, CRM, and Accounting screens inside WordPress.

Data Preservation

Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Codersly ERP.
  3. Go to Codersly ERP in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Start with Company setup, then add HRM, CRM, or Accounting records as needed.
  5. Review Pro placeholder screens if your business needs advanced ERP workflows.
sections.faq:
Is Codersly ERP an ERP for Small Business?

Yes. Codersly ERP is designed as an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It provides admin-based HRM, CRM, and Accounting screens for basic business record management.

Can I use Codersly ERP as a small business ERP plugin in WordPress?

Yes. You can use Codersly ERP to manage basic employee, leave, CRM contact, company, customer, vendor, transaction, product, report, and settings records from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I use Codersly ERP without WooCommerce?

Yes. Codersly ERP can be used for HRM, CRM, Accounting, company records, reports, settings, and CSV tools without WooCommerce.

Does the Free plugin include WooCommerce sync?

No. WooCommerce order, customer, product, inventory, sales report, and accounting sync are premium features handled by Codersly ERP Pro.

Why do I see a WooCommerce Integration screen in the Free plugin?

The WooCommerce Integration screen in the Free plugin is a Pro placeholder. It explains the available premium WooCommerce ERP workflows but does not include WooCommerce sync logic in the Free plugin.

Does the Free plugin include license activation?

No. License activation belongs to Codersly ERP Pro. The Free plugin does not create a License menu.

Does the Free plugin contain Pro business logic?

No. The Free plugin only displays upgrade placeholders for Pro features. Premium business logic is kept in Codersly ERP Pro.

Which Pro features are shown as placeholders?

The Free plugin shows placeholders for Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Accounting Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, WooCommerce Integration, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Does Codersly ERP delete my saved data on uninstall?

No. Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added WooCommerce Integration Pro placeholder under Accounting for premium order, customer, product, inventory, sales report, and ERP accounting sync.
  • Added module-specific dashboard, tab, placeholder, and admin UI icons.
  • Improved Codersly ERP sidebar branding with default, hover, and active icon states.
  • Replaced unrelated ecommerce-style icons outside WooCommerce-related screens.
  • Improved Free dashboard Pro highlights for Codersly ERP Pro 1.0.3 compatibility.
  • Clarified that WooCommerce sync logic remains outside the Free plugin; the Free WooCommerce screen is a Pro placeholder only.
  • Improved readme wording for ERP for Small Business, small business ERP, HRM, CRM, Accounting, and WooCommerce Pro placeholder discovery.

1.0.2

  • Shortened the readme short description to stay within the WordPress.org 150-character limit.
  • Improved readme keywords and descriptions for ERP for Small Business, small business ERP, HRM, CRM, and Accounting discovery.
  • Removed the Accounting admin helper/debug text shown above the Accounting tabs.
  • Fixed Free-to-Pro embedded admin rendering so Pro Add New/Edit screens keep native form, input, select, option, textarea, button, datalist, nonce, and hidden fields.
  • Fixed Pro dropdown fields appearing as joined text such as SelectActiveDraftFinalizedPaidClosedInactive when rendered through the Free admin shell.
  • Improved Free placeholder routing to the matching Pro HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, Tools, Settings, Reports, and Advanced Permission screens.
  • Kept premium feature implementation out of the Free plugin; Free screens remain placeholders/upsell holders only.
  • Added compatibility for Codersly ERP Pro 1.0.2 module rendering.

1.0.1

  • Initial WordPress.org submission as Codersly ERP.
  • Added admin HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, Settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens.
  • Added nonce verification, permission checks, prefixed hooks/options/namespaces, escaped output, changelog, and POT file.
